name: no-cohorts-month-end
about: The shape production sends until Q-AD34: no cohorts at all, on the last day of the month (0 days left).

output.headline: On 2026-10-31, 2 campaigns closed out the month with $284.25 spent, 7 leads, and a $40.61 cost per lead across 14,600 impressions.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the stronger performer, delivering 6 of the day's 7 leads at $30.75 per lead on $184.50 spend, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, and a 1.5% click rate.

Dedicated night runs brought in 1 lead at a cost per lead of $99.75, with $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a 1.1% click rate — worth keeping an eye on given the gap from the other campaign.
Combined for the day: 203 clicks on 14,600 impressions at a 1.4% click rate.
2026-10 is now closed with 0 days left; total Meta spend for the month came to $8,124.50.
No cohort data was reported for this period, so there is nothing to review on lead progression stages.
